# CaddyManager rhad00

Alpha reverse proxy manager built on Caddy Server.

Source: https://github.com/rhad00/CaddyManager

Notes:
- Experimental Git-build template.
- First deployment can be slow because Docker builds from GitHub source.
- Default login: admin@caddymanager.local / changeme123
- Change the default password immediately.
- Ports are intentionally offset to avoid conflict with existing Caddy Server.
